stem: Which TCP port is used by SSH?
source: SSH uses TCP port 22. The client connects to the server listening on TCP 22 and establishes an encrypted session for remote administration. Telnet uses TCP 23 and does not provide this encryption.

stem: On a broadcast OSPF network, which interface priority makes a router ineligible for DR election?
source: On an OSPF broadcast segment, an interface priority of 0 makes a router ineligible to become DR or BDR. Among eligible candidates, higher priority wins; Router ID breaks ties. Election is non-preemptive: a newly arriving higher-priority router does not automatically replace the current DR.

stem: Two installed IPv4 routes match a destination: 10.20.0.0/16 via OSPF and 10.20.30.0/24 via RIP. Which route is used for 10.20.30.8?
source: Forwarding selects the longest matching prefix among installed routes. 10.20.30.8 matches both 10.20.0.0/16 and 10.20.30.0/24, so /24 is selected. Administrative distance compares route sources for the same destination prefix during route installation; it does not override longest-prefix matching during forwarding.

stem: Which command forces a switch interface into trunk mode?
source:
The command switchport mode trunk sets an Ethernet switch interface to trunk mode, allowing multiple VLANs on that link. Use show interfaces trunk to check operational trunking and allowed VLANs. Access mode carries a single data VLAN. Example: SW1(config)# interface g0/1
SW1(config-if)# switchport mode trunk
SW1# show interfaces trunk
